How talent-share works

How to book
and attend a program.

Start by checking whether a program fits your goal, level, and schedule. You can read the details before signing up, then book and attend through your account.

Browse programs↗
Start here

Four steps to your first session.

01

Find a program

Browse programs in the app. Narrow your search by subject, level, price, and online or in person.

02

Read the details

Meet the provider, check the outcomes and materials, and choose the date that works for you.

03

Book your place

See the program price, service fee, and total before paying. Your receipt keeps the same breakdown.

04

Attend your program

Join from your program page or head to the venue. Your schedule, files, and program conversations stay together.

Before you book

Check the details
before you book.

Read what the program covers, who it is for, and what you need to take part.

Read the provider’s profile and portfolio, and look at any reviews. If a requirement is unclear, use the program’s message option to ask. You can clarify experience or equipment requirements before paying.

Your pre-booking checklist

What to check

  • Level, outcomes, and prior knowledge
  • Online or in person, with the location where relevant
  • Every session included in your selected program
  • Materials, preparation, and the checkout total
  • The current cancellation policy
Attending a session

Find your session
on the program page.

For live online learning, open the schedule in your program and join from there. Confirmed seekers can enter from 15 minutes before the start. Video, screen sharing, and live chat are built into talent-share.

For in-person learning, use the program details to plan where to be and what to bring. Your schedule and provider announcements remain with the program, so check them before heading out.

Explore the classroom features↗
After the session

Find your files and follow-up questions

Access shared resources and stay in touch with your provider between sessions.

Resources and conversation

Download files your provider has shared. Continue a question in the program discussion, or use a private message for something individual. Repeating dates in a program series share their discussion, announcements, and file library.

Your next session and your review

Your learning dashboard separates upcoming, in-progress, and completed programs. Find what is next without sorting through old bookings. After a completed enrollment, you can leave a review from the dashboard.

you want to join.

Check the provider, level, and schedule before you book. You can explore public program pages without an account.
